name: Grant cycle management
task: Given a funder RFP, prior-year 990, program budget, and last cycle's reporting template, produce a complete application package plus a compliance crosswalk mapping every funder requirement to an evidence location.
gates: every RFP requirement id appears exactly once in crosswalk
budget totals reconcile to restriction_rules.json within 0.5%
no unrestricted-fund line charged to a restricted category
score: 0.6 * field-level budget accuracy vs reference + 0.4 * narrative rubric (evidence-anchored yes/no probes)
why_agents_fail_today: ALE failure taxonomy: 75% of failures are Understanding/Approach, not execution. Funder-specific conventions are the domain knowledge agents lack.
economic_value: Grant writer + compliance officer hours per cycle; clawback risk reduction. Market anchor: grant management software ~$1.9-2.3B global, ~10% CAGR, government is largest end-user segment.
